steps.text: What happened to Babel? Any Sarkaz in contact with Her Majesty Theresa at the time would've asked this question.
W definitely saw the truth, but she said nothing during the long journey.
I didn't ask, and neither did Ines. But, I think she's closer to the truth than I am.
Before I knew it, I found myself trailing behind everyone else.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Of course.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yes, it'll be fine. I'll keep contact with the other teams.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...By your command.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Guys, it looks like we'll be stationed here for a while.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The scouts spotted a Catastrophe brewing, with no Catastrophe Messengers nearby. We should stay as far away as possible, just in case.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We can't risk it, no matter what.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...A Catastrophe, huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's rare to see one raging in the wilderness.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But we have plenty of experience dealing with Originium in Kazdel, so no need to panic.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Where's W?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She's with her team.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Need her for something?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm... not sure. She's changed a lot.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Do you think her personality would change that much just because Theresa is gone?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's too calm. It's unlike her.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But when we found her on the battlefield earlier, she still had that cynical, sarcastic expression.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If anything, she's only gotten worse.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: That's odd. I never thought you'd be perceptive enough to pick up on these subtle warning signs.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Save the jabs. If W's being quiet, that warning sign's far from 'subtle.'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W, she... Oh—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Look, the clouds are converging on the other side of the mountain, and the air pressure has changed drastically... Is that a Catastrophe cloud?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...It might not be safe to station here given the size of that thing. Notify all our forces to retreat 50 kilometers along our original route.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Find W, and make it quick.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...I don't take orders from you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You know, the feeling W gives off now... is just like that thing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ahah...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W! What are you doing—!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The wind— is so strong here!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm enjoying the Catastrophe, what else?!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Are you insane—

steps.name: W
steps.text: What'd you say? I— can't— hear— you—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tch... I forgot you were always a lunatic.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't get the Sarkaz on your team killed with you!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I already told them to evacuate with Hoederer. I'm not stupid— Hah!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W! I'm telling you, be careful! Damn it!

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're the one who should stay back. You're not gonna make it if you fall down there—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And you think you will? If you don't want to die, get your ass back here—!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...What the hell are you two doing?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Ask her.

steps.name: W
steps.text: She insists on clinging to me.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Fortunately, we didn't lose anyone from W's team. Otherwise, we'd get court-martialed long before we get to join Reuinon.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Let's all head back and rest first, then wait for the news.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's wrong with fighting during a Catastrophe? Are you afraid of the storm? Or of Oripathy?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I'd just rather not die an early death.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let's get ourselves ready.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It'll be a real special experience.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What? I'm not upset. It's not like we're a couple of ornery kids you have to break apart.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I can say... that W did a good job taking care of her team.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Rare to hear you say that.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Say what? ...I have no idea if she's just a lunatic, or if she's... Goddamnit.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She's no damn storm cloud. She is the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: (*Swears*...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ahahaha~!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: ...You're in a good mood.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's some news, but you don't get to hear it until we're out of this trash heap of a country.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: That can't be why you set our rendezvous point right under a Catastrophe, right...? Are you trying to get me killed?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey, don't put it that way.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do you know what the biggest perk of being a lunatic is?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'm not sure I want to know. But, I already have a pretty good idea just from following you, boss.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's this. The crazier shit you do, the less others question you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: W
steps.text: The 'Rhodes Island' already left Kazdel, right?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: To be specific, we don't have any reports of a landship that big getting taken in by His Ma... by Theresis's.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Good enough.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Mm, so we do have a lead after all.
We have more and more fresh faces on the team, but I feel better, knowing that I left Kazdel.
Among those traveling with me are both friends and enemies, but it's always been volatile like that.
Mercenaries don't care too much about the past because for our kind, life and death are easy come, easy go.
Maybe because the war ended too quickly, we immediately plunged first into the next battle without ever tasting a moment of peace.
...This kind of hope could just be another poison. Since the beginning, we've always needed war and conflict to ease this balance.
W is the best example of this. She's long become drunk on it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Welcome.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Warriors from afar.
War has never been something that can be avoided.
I've always known that, of course. But at that moment, I truly realized it.
War has permeated every corner of this world. It always has, ever since the first sentient thing was born.
And, we will become mired in it again.
